title: Comparison of transepithelial corneal crosslinking with epithelium-off crosslinking (epithelium-off CXL) in adult Pakistani population with progressive keratoconus

groups.description: Transepithelial (epithelium-on) CXL with Peschke TE riboflavin (0.25% riboflavin, 1.2% HPMC, 0.01% benzalkonium chloride), UVA 3 mW/cm2 for 30 min; corneas of 375-400 µm at the thinnest point were scheduled for this technique (with hypotonic riboflavin until 400 µm before irradiation); 32 eyes of 32 patients aged 18-33 years with progressive keratoconus, Rawalpindi 2014-2016, quasi-experimental comparison. Procedure described as cross-linking only.

Standard epithelium-off CXL (9 mm epithelial debridement, Peschke M 0.1% riboflavin with 1.1% HPMC every 2 min for 20 min, UVA 3 mW/cm2 for 30 min, 5.4 J/cm2); 32 eyes of 32 patients aged 18-33 years with progressive keratoconus. Procedure described as cross-linking only.

series.notes: Mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: quantitative variables presented as mean ± SD); unit logMAR (Methods: CDVA as Snellen visual acuity converted to logMAR notation; Results: logMAR CDVA). Numbers of eyes in the Table 2 header: 32 at every visit to 1 year and 26 at 18 months.

Mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: quantitative variables presented as mean ± SD); unit logMAR (Methods: CDVA as Snellen visual acuity converted to logMAR notation; Results: logMAR CDVA). Numbers of eyes in the Table 3 header: 32 at every visit to 1 year and 27 at 18 months; the Results text and Table 4 give 24 eyes at 18 months.

notes: UDVA, spherical equivalent, astigmatism, steep K, Sim K, Kmax and thinnest pachymetry (Tables 1-4) are mentioned here only.
Attrition at 18 months is attributed to change of residence or follow-up at nearby hospitals (ordinary attrition).

Allocation: corneas of at least 400 µm at the thinnest point were allotted to either technique and corneas of 375-400 µm to transepithelial CXL, so the groups differ in preoperative pachymetry (Table 1).
Neither arm is declared experimental (two techniques compared, epithelium-off described as standard): both groups are control.
